Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS (Affinity Purification-Mass Spectrometry) using a Strep-tag to pull down METTL8 and its interactors. While the paper focuses on RNA methylation (m3C), the proteomics part is a standard bottom-up DDA run to identify interacting proteins.

scope: Strep tagged proteins were then purified by incubating whole cell lysates with MagStrep “type3” XT beads (IBA Life Sciences) for 5-6 h at 4 °C.
METTL8-Strep was affinity purified from whole cell extracts on Strep-Tactin resin, eluted with biotin, and analyzed by silver staining.

To identify METTL8-interacting proteins, we performed a large-scale purification from human cells expressing control or METTL8-Strep and subjected the entire eluted samples for proteomic analysis by LC-MS.

Ontology_SampleSourceAndScope_prompt.notes: The material analyzed by LC-MS/MS was the eluate from an affinity purification of METTL8-Strep complexes using MagStrep beads. While METTL8 is described as a mitochondria-associated protein, the proteomics was performed on the purified complex eluted from whole cell lysates, not a pre-fractionated mitochondrial sample.
